# Use cases

Built-in use cases (code, audience, what the agent can do, endpoints under the base path). A new use case
follows the same structure in a use_case pack.

## MAS Appointment scheduling (member)

- can: Show next available slots; Book visit types; Suggest telehealth; Bundle care-gap visits
- escalate: No slot within the wait standard; Urgent symptoms
- never: Triage symptoms; Book with non-participating providers
- verification: name, date of birth, member ID; handoff queue: SCHEDULING; caregiver scope: APPOINTMENTS
- endpoints: `GET /providers/{npi}/availability`, `POST /appointments`

## MBN Benefits navigation (member)

- can: Quote copay, coinsurance, deductible and out-of-pocket status; Explain allowances and covered services; Cite the plan summary
- escalate: Eligibility disputes; Grievances; Coverage exceptions
- never: Promise coverage; Interpret legal terms; Disclose beyond the verified scope
- verification: name, date of birth, member ID; handoff queue: MEMBER_SERVICES; caregiver scope: BENEFITS
- endpoints: `GET /members/{member_id}/accumulators`, `GET /members/{member_id}/benefits`

## MCI Claims inquiry (member)

- can: Report claim status; Explain allowed, paid and member responsibility; Explain denial reasons
- escalate: Surprise-bill disputes; Payment integrity; Suspected errors above threshold
- never: Reprocess or override claims; Promise payment; Give legal advice
- verification: name, date of birth, member ID; handoff queue: CLAIMS_MEMBER; caregiver scope: CLAIMS
- endpoints: `GET /claims/{claim_id}`, `GET /members/{member_id}/claims`

## MPC PCP change (member)

- can: Validate the new PCP; Apply the change with an effective date; Send confirmation
- escalate: Continuity-of-care exceptions; County restrictions with no alternative
- never: Change PCP without verification; Assign a closed-panel PCP
- verification: name, date of birth, member ID; handoff queue: MEMBER_SERVICES; caregiver scope: PCP_CHANGE
- endpoints: `PUT /members/{member_id}/pcp`

## MPS Provider search (member)

- can: Search the directory by specialty, distance, language and accessibility; Show ratings and next availability
- escalate: Network adequacy complaints; No in-network option within the access standard
- never: Recommend clinically; Recommend a termed or pending provider; Share unverified information
- verification: member ID; handoff queue: NETWORK_SUPPORT
- endpoints: `GET /providers/search`

## PAP Appeals (provider)

- can: Open appeals; List documents and deadlines; Report status and decision; Show reprocessing history
- escalate: Late filings; Bulk or systemic denials; External review requests
- never: Predict outcomes; Waive deadlines
- verification: NPI, TIN, claim ID; handoff queue: APPEALS
- endpoints: `GET /appeals/{appeal_id}`, `POST /claims/{claim_id}/appeals`

## PAS Authorization status (provider)

- can: Report status and due time; List required documents; Give determination and appeal/P2P steps; Accept documents; Route urgent requests for expedited review
- escalate: All clinical review; Urgent cases near SLA breach
- never: Approve or deny; Interpret criteria as a decision
- verification: NPI, TIN, patient identifiers; handoff queue: UM_INTAKE
- endpoints: `GET /authorizations/{auth_id}/status`, `POST /authorizations/{auth_id}/documents`

## PCS Claim status (provider)

- can: Report status, pend reason and expected date; Explain denial code in plain language; Give corrected-claim guidance
- escalate: Contract interpretation; Payment integrity; System errors
- never: Disclose without NPI/TIN verification; Promise payment; Alter claims
- verification: NPI, TIN, claim ID or member + date of service; handoff queue: CLAIMS_TIER2
- endpoints: `GET /claims/{claim_id}/status`

## PEV Eligibility verification (provider)

- can: Return eligibility for a date of service; Give plan, PCP and cost-share status; Report COB and PA indicators with a reference number
- escalate: Retro changes; Enrollment pending cases; Data conflicts
- never: Guarantee payment; Disclose beyond minimum necessary
- verification: NPI, TIN, patient name/DOB or member ID; handoff queue: ELIGIBILITY_SUPPORT
- endpoints: `POST /eligibility/verify`

## PPI Payment inquiry (provider)

- can: Give payment date, amount, method and trace; Explain adjustments and offsets
- escalate: Misdirected payments; Wrong payee; Disputed recoupments
- never: Change payment instructions; Issue payments
- verification: NPI, TIN, claim ID; handoff queue: PROVIDER_PAYMENTS
- endpoints: `GET /claims/{claim_id}/payments`

Caregiver scopes in use: MAS=APPOINTMENTS, MBN=BENEFITS, MBP=BILLING, MCI=CLAIMS, MPA=PA_STATUS, MPC=PCP_CHANGE
